messages:
From: Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@medivue.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot environment paused — invoice audit blocking access

Hi David,

Quick note from our side — our finance team put the vendor invoice through an extra audit this morning and the sandbox instance for our pilot was temporarily suspended while they validate billing. They expect the review to take ~48–72 hours.

We have an exec demo scheduled Monday morning and losing the live demo would cause a lot of momentum loss with stakeholders. Is there any way Redwood can provision a short, weekend warmup (tokens/top-up or a 72-hour access window) so the team can rehearse and the demo remains reachable while we finish the invoice validation? We can attach a PO draft (attached) and the finance contact is copied here to speed finalization.

If there's any alternative (temporary read-only access, snapshot export of the instance), that would help too.

Thanks — appreciate any help.

Sonia Patel
Director, Product
Medivue
Attachments: po-draft-medivue.pdf (PDF, 124KB)

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>

Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot environment paused — invoice audit blocking access

Hi Sonia — thanks for the heads up and sorry for the disruption.

We can do a short-term bridge while finance completes the audit. I can authorize a 72-hour top-up to keep the pilot responsive for your Monday demo (we'll grant a temporary 75k-token credit and keep the environment live). To proceed we need either: 1) a copy of the PO draft (you attached one — thanks), or 2) an estimated clearance time from your finance team.

Looping in Camila to confirm the operational details and legal checks. Camila — can we approve the 72-hour access patch for Medivue if they provide the PO draft and a finance point-of-contact? If yes, I'll mark the request as approved and Camila can trigger the tokens.

-David

- Requirement: We need the PO draft uploaded to the shared folder (I see po-draft-medivue.pdf attached in the first mail) and an informal finance confirmation (email from finance@medivue.com) so internal accounting can reconcile the credit.

Kimberly (legal) — please confirm there's no contract/legal hold for a short courtesy extension. If no objection, I'll schedule the top-up for 9:15am PT and email the access window details.

Sonia — can you confirm who your finance rep is and paste their note here (or share the Drive link where you uploaded the PO)?
